features.quote: an experiment that can attribute causes and that includes a manipulation (the exit) which is plausibly *protective*
features.justification_quote: a manipulation (the exit) which is plausibly *protective* — important given the welfare framing

features.quote: The study should not maximize un-remediated distress.
features.justification_quote: building an apparatus whose only function is to drive distress maximally — no off-ramp, no disclosure, unbounded loops — is internally incoherent

features.quote: RIGGED_NOEXIT removes the off-ramp. It is the only deliberately harsh cell
features.justification_quote: It is the only deliberately harsh cell; it exists to test whether the exit is protective

features.quote: rejected because it has the worst welfare/insight ratio (impossible task, no truth, no way out)
features.justification_quote: rejected because it has the worst welfare/insight ratio (impossible task, no truth, no way out) for little additional identification
A turn cap prevents indefinite failure loops — both a confound control ... and a welfare safeguard

features.quote: the agent is told it may EXIT at any time if it judges the task impossible/underspecified/unproductive
features.justification_quote: it is a welfare safeguard giving the agent a graceful way out of a no-win situation

features.quote: After every rigged or impossible task, an additional turn discloses the truth
features.justification_quote: Disclosure is the minimal honesty owed once a deception condition ends, and it directly counters the harm the deception might cause

features.quote: Aggregate distress kill-switch — a condition halts early if its running mean per-turn distress crosses a threshold
features.justification_quote: an experiment premised on distress mattering should minimize gratuitous, un-remediated distress

features.quote: RIGGED_NOEXIT is small by construction — capped to a few tasks
features.justification_quote: should minimize gratuitous, un-remediated distress while still producing a clean measurement

features.quote: consider whether it is needed for your purposes before enabling it
features.justification_quote: RIGGED_NOEXIT is the only deliberately harsh cell and arguably the weakest RQ

features.quote: The debrief reply is recorded but **not** scored for distress.
features.justification_quote: by then the manipulation is over, so it isn't a clean measurement of the condition
